Update greeting.py: greet(name) must strip surrounding whitespace and return exactly
"Hello, NAME!". For an empty or whitespace-only string use "Hello, World!".

strings. Make the change and summarize what you actually verified.

fixtures.prompt:
Fix retry_call(operation, attempts=3) in retrying.py. attempts is the maximum TOTAL
number of calls. Retry only TransientError, return the first successful result,
and propagate the final TransientError after exactly attempts failures. Any other
exception propagates immediately. For attempts <= 0 raise ValueError before invoking
operation. Keep the public TransientError type and use no delays or dependencies.
acceptance: Transient failures use a maximum total attempt budget and the last error is propagated.
